facts.text: NJIT was established on February 9, 1881, as the Newark Technical School, and opened with 88 students.
facts.sourceNote: Wikipedia: New Jersey Institute of Technology

facts.text: The school adopted the name Newark College of Engineering in 1930.
facts.sourceNote: Wikipedia: New Jersey Institute of Technology

facts.text: The New Jersey School of Architecture was added in 1973.
facts.sourceNote: Wikipedia: New Jersey Institute of Technology

facts.text: Newark College of Engineering officially became the New Jersey Institute of Technology on January 1, 1975.
facts.sourceNote: Wikipedia: New Jersey Institute of Technology

eras.caption: Newark Technical School opens with 88 students.

eras.caption: It becomes the Newark College of Engineering.

eras.caption: It becomes the New Jersey Institute of Technology.
eras.details: A 1975 city college campus with concrete and brick buildings, students in 1970s clothing and hairstyles, 1970s cars.

eras.caption: Today: a big university, and little me.
eras.details: A lively modern university campus today with a very young sapling tree with a support stake in the foreground.
